messages:
maya_marketing: Heads-up — the weekly dashboard is showing a +48% inbound conversion spike this morning but SFDC lead counts flat. Anyone else seeing mismatch? :thinking:
sofia_analytics: @maya_marketing yep i flagged it. Looks like the webinar gate event duplicated for users hitting the CTA twice. Raw events show two registration events with different session ids.
liam_growth: can you paste the raw query? I can diff against GA4.
sofia_analytics: here's quick SQL I ran:
```
SELECT user_id, event_name, count(*) as cnt
FROM events
WHERE event_name IN ('webinar_register','signup_complete')
AND event_time > now() - interval '48 hours'
GROUP BY user_id, event_name
HAVING count(*) > 1
```
sofia_analytics: results had ~420 users with duplicate reg events, majority from EU time windows, a couple of mobile UA spikes.
devon_ops: might be related to the UTM rewrite we shipped yesterday — we started adding utm_term fallback twice for certain referrers. Could cause duplicate client ids upstream.
park_salesops: FYI a handful of those users did get created twice in SFDC but later merged by the dedupe job. still weird the dashboard shows them as separate leads before merge.
maya_marketing: proposal: add a short-term filter on the dashboard to exclude events where session_count=1? or dedupe by (user_id + normalized timestamp) on the materialized view.
liam_growth: i'm +1 for dedupe by (user_id, date_trunc('minute', event_time)) as a stopgap. longer term we need to fix the ingestion pipeline and the UTM rewrite.
analytics-bot: nightly_pipeline_counts: processed=1,234,567 deduped=1,234,103 dropped=464
sofia_analytics: i'll push a patch to the materialized view and redeploy to staging. will share PR link when ready.
maya_marketing: timeline? we need corrected numbers for tomorrow's exec readout and the weekly snapshot.
sofia_analytics: aiming EOD today. if anything slips i'll notify and we can mark current week as "partial" in the slide deck.
park_salesops: also let's export a snapshot of the pre-fix dashboard CSV and send to sales ops so they can reconcile any leads that pop in post-merge.
maya_marketing: good call. please add a short note on the dashboard: "temporary dedupe in staging — numbers will adjust" until we confirm. :thumbsup:
liam_growth: once staging looks good i'll run a holdback (10%) to compare downstream SFDC creation rates before switching prod.
sofia_analytics: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/analytics/pulls/412 — includes the dedupe change + test. staging numbers already down ~0.9%.
maya_marketing: thanks team. keep this thread alive with updates. we want clean numbers for the KPI review tomorrow. :eyes:
